repo_notes.content: A starter template. The value to a reader is the wiring between Express, Drizzle, JWT and the OpenAPI document, not any one route.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: Routes, services and middleware each have a matching tests/ directory; treat the tests as the specification when a behaviour is ambiguous.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: API Architecture
pages.purpose: The request path end to end: Express 5 app assembly, middleware order, routing, the service layer, and where the OpenAPI document is generated.

pages.title: Routes and Schemas
pages.purpose: Every route under src/routes/, the schemas that validate each request and response, and how a schema becomes an OpenAPI path.

pages.title: Services
pages.purpose: The service layer under src/services/: the boundary between HTTP concerns and business logic, and the contract each service exposes.

pages.title: Data Layer
pages.purpose: Drizzle ORM setup under src/db/: schema definition, migrations, connection handling and query patterns.

pages.title: Authentication and Middleware
pages.purpose: JWT issuance and verification, the auth middleware, and the rest of the middleware chain including error handling and request logging.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The Vitest suite: unit tests per layer, integration tests against a live app instance, and the helpers that set them up.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Running the API in a container, the environment it expects, and the health and readiness surfaces.
